Nvidia Data Center Financing Faces Uncertainty
In a Saturday post on X, O’Leary declared, “The bank of NVIDIA is closed,” arguing that financing new data centers through the chipmaker’s balance sheet may no longer be viable.

“The idea that you could finance new data centers under the balance sheet of NVIDIA is over,” he said, adding that the company would remain “under scrutiny for a while” as investigations he referenced are expected to begin Dec. 10.
O’Leary also praised Nvidia CFO Colette Kress, saying, “I think they have the right CEO in Colette because she’s the CFO.”

O’Leary also pushed back against political opposition to data-center construction, arguing that the projects support middle-class workers, including engineers, construction workers, plumbers and businesses supplying commercial glass.
“Most of the governors and senators in every state that won said, ‘We gotta stop building these data centers, and we gotta help the middle class,'” he said.
O’Leary challenged that position, asking, “Well hold on, who are the middle class?” He argued that workers and businesses involved in building data centers are themselves part of the middle class.
“I think you’re going to see them say, ‘Just kidding,’ about the data centers,” he added.
